SS Rajamouli Honoured by Cinémathèque Française in Paris

Filmmaker SS Rajamouli has been honoured by the Cinémathèque Française, a French film archive, in Paris. The institution has named a chair after the director, known for the "Baahubali" films. This recognition highlights the international appreciation for his work.
